description: A warm, organic living room vignette with an artisan-California sensibility. The wall is finished in a warm sandy beige plaster with a softly undulating handmade texture catching the light at gentle angles. A wide, low sideboard or media console in warm dark walnut with flat panel cabinet doors and subtle inset hardware sits against the wall, its top surface styled with a collection of ceramic vessels in various earthy shapes and heights — a squat round jar, a taller narrow neck vase, a squat belly vase — all in sandy, taupe, and ochre glazes. Beside them, a small stack of warm brown books and a small terracotta pot holding an olive tree or herb sprig with silver-green foliage. Natural light enters from a tall window on the left, its warm afternoon light falling on the plaster wall and sideboard surface. To the right, a generous armchair in warm sand or greige upholstery is partially visible, a loosely draped grey wool throw blanket folded over one arm. A natural jute area rug covers the floor beneath. A warm amber glow washes downward on the plaster wall above the sideboard from a wall-mounted source — the light emanates from a form with a matte sandy ceramic body and dark metal arm detail, its warm cone of illumination pooling on the ceramics below. The mood is earthy, crafted, and casually sophisticated. Camera at standing eye-level using a normal to slightly wide lens, with a three-quarter corner composition capturing the full sideboard width and the chair fragment at right. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category.
